core.headline: First-floor flat with lift, Juliet balcony and parking
core.summary: Guide Price £195,000. A two-bedroom purpose-built flat on the first floor of Albion House, New Road, Chatham, with lift access, open-plan kitchen/living room, Juliet balcony and one allocated parking space.
core.listing:
A two-bedroom purpose-built flat on the first floor of Albion House, New Road, Chatham. The property has lift access, an open-plan kitchen/living room with a Juliet balcony, and one allocated parking space.

The open-plan kitchen/living room offers space for cooking, dining and relaxing. The Juliet balcony is accessed from this room. There are two bedrooms and a bathroom.

The flat comes with one allocated parking space.

The property is in Chatham, ME4.

Guide Price £195,000. Leasehold with 99 years remaining and a service charge of £1,450 per year (year ending March 2026). Council Tax Band B (Medway Council). EPC rating C. Mains electricity, mains water (metered), mains sewerage and gas central heating. Broadband: FTTC. Mobile signal: good outdoor coverage on major networks. Building safety, restrictions, rights and easements, flooding, coastal erosion, planning, accessibility and coalfield or mining issues: none known.
